scope: existing local-only RGB PNGs, high-alpha core interpreted with the fixed metrics intersection
observations: All five local-only cores show a muted asphalt texture without an obvious red/cyan ghost or dark rim. Black exterior and fragmented low-alpha silhouettes are outside this core observation; low-alpha RGB was not normalized.
texture_observation: The measured image-space HF RMS falls to about 0.50-0.59 of direct field sampling and its correlation is weak/negative. Full grain preservation is not supported. Gaussian footprint filtering, direct mesh texture sampling alias and projection/sampling differences are not separated by this single diagnostic.
GS_compositing: sRGB-valued alpha compositing; EOTF of straight recovered sRGB is a colour diagnostic, not a recovered linear-light reflectance model
source_vs_conversion_vs_occlusion: The accepted shared input is held fixed. This comparison measures the conversion/raster readout on a fixed intersection. Original native and actor occlusion are absent from the local-only layer and must be assessed from the existing actual joint/group controls.
